text: Notemus S. Sophronii doctrinam contra Monophysitas, Monothelitarum fratres, quorum hæreseos malleus ipse fuit.
anchorLine: ὑπόστασιν (1), ὁ ἐκ θεῖας τε καὶ ἀνθρωπίνης συγχει-
en: Let us note Sophronius's teaching against the Monophysites, the brothers of the Monothelites, of whose heresy he himself was the hammer.

text: En ut S. Sophronius primatum Petri in apostolico ordine belle tuetur, etiam supra Paulum ; quorum dignitatem neoterici aliquot, male erga sedem Petri Romanam affecti, æquare volebant : ita ut ipsorum doctrina inter damnatas merito propositiones relata sit.
anchorLine: τὴν τάξιν συγχέουσαν (2). Ἀλλ' ἐν τῇ ἐνότητι τῆς ἀποστολικῆς
en: See how Sophronius ably defends the primacy of Peter within the apostolic order, even above Paul; some recent writers, ill disposed toward the Roman see of Peter, wished to make their dignity equal, so that their teaching was rightly included among the condemned propositions.

text: Notemus morem Hierosolymitanæ Ecclesiæ celebrandi festum sanctorum Petri et Pauli quarto a Christi natalibus die.
anchorLine: τετάρτην ἑαυτοῖς διετηρήσαντο (3), τῶν
en: Let us note the custom of the Church of Jerusalem of celebrating the feast of Saints Peter and Paul on the fourth day after the birth of Christ.
